title: Reconcile Transactions in Accounting
description: Complete the reconcile transactions workflow in the Accounting module using a validated, repeatable process.
prerequisites: You are signed in with accountant access or equivalent permissions.
You can open the Accounting module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for reconcile transactions are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the Accounting module from the main navigation.
Locate the reconcile transactions entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for reconcile transactions.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Reconcile Transactions completes without warnings or blockers.
Resulting records are visible in the expected Accounting views.
Any generated output is stored in the expected location with traceable metadata.
commonErrors: Required fields are missing during reconcile transactions.
Permission constraints prevent completion of reconcile transactions.
Output is created but not linked to the expected workflow context.
recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun reconcile transactions.
Confirm role permissions for accountant and retry after access refresh.
Re-open the module, relink output artifacts, and verify final state.

faq.question: When should I rerun reconcile transactions?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm reconcile transactions is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
